title: Edit-items Add mode can start a line at the customer's remembered last price instead of the tier price shown
symptom: From the lead (owner ruling 2026-10-03). In Add mode a line can start at the customer's remembered last price instead of the tier price shown. Money, mobile, medium. Lane: unsorted (Mac).

title: When the customer-pricing fetch fails, the substitute picker shows list price while the server bills the tier price
location: apps/mobile substitute picker; apps/web substitute picker (see B1007)
symptom: From the lead (owner ruling 2026-10-03). On a customer-pricing fetch failure the picker shows list while the server bills tier; it should show price unavailable or block, never a wrong number. Money, mobile, medium. Lane: unsorted (Mac).

title: Dashboard requests that FAIL show the empty-state text (All clear, No runs scheduled, No drivers found) instead of a failure message with Retry
location: apps/web dashboard cards (urgent orders, runs, drivers); same family as B1015
symptom: From the lead (same family as B1015). On the dashboard, when the requests FAIL the page still shows All clear / No urgent orders, No runs scheduled and No drivers found, reading failure as an empty result. They should show fixed failure copy plus Retry, with the empty-state text only on a successful empty response. Web, medium. Lane: PC builder B, after #3119.

title: A read-only billing reconciliation report is missing: list every subscription item against TenantAddon rows (orphan items, rows without items, amount mismatches)
location: apps/api billing (reconciliation report script or endpoint); blocked on #3129
symptom: From the lead (SA-646), blocked on #3129 landing. A read-only reconciliation report that lists every subscription item vs TenantAddon rows (orphan items, rows missing items, and amount mismatches) so billing drift is visible. Money and billing, api, medium.

title: One billing product per add-on SKU: price_data currently creates or uses a product per call; consolidate
location: apps/api billing add-on subscription item creation (price_data); blocked on #3129
symptom: From the lead (SA-646), blocked on #3129 landing. price_data currently creates or uses a product per call; consolidate to one billing product per add-on SKU. Billing, api, low.

title: The buyer Reorder path (template reorder, createOrderFromTemplate for buyers) does not apply the portal-visibility gate that checkout applies, so a hidden product can be reordered
location: apps/api buyer reorder and createOrderFromTemplate path; the #2856 portal-visibility gate (assertBuyerMayOrder) is the model
symptom: From the lead. The buyer Reorder path (template reorder / createOrderFromTemplate for buyers) does NOT apply the #2856 portal-visibility gate that checkout applies, so a hidden product can be reordered by a buyer. Buyer and api, medium. Lane: Mac (after #3017 and #3052).

title: Invoice update() no-items recalc path (a discount or shipping-only PATCH) rebuilds the tax amount without category tax and without the customer tax-exempt check
location: apps/api invoices.service.ts update() recalc, the no-items branch; related B1026, B1030, B1027
symptom: From the Mac Lead (docs lane's B1030 work, Opus-noted). The no-items recalc branch of invoice update() (a discount or shipping-only PATCH) rebuilds taxAmount WITHOUT category tax and WITHOUT the customer tax-exempt check. A shipping-only PATCH can therefore under-bill category tax and tax an exempt customer. Money, api, likely high.

title: Mobile NewOrderScreen with the sheet closed: the Units are still loading toast covers the bottom Confirm row for a few seconds and a stale Added toast stacks above it
location: apps/mobile NewOrderScreen toast placement (Units are still loading, Added toasts)
symptom: From the Mac Lead (lead-approved), found in Mac F2's #3115 pixel review (#2554 5977093185). With the sheet closed, the Units are still loading toast covers the bottom Confirm row for a few seconds, and a stale Added toast stacks above it. Mobile, low. Lane: Lane B, later.

title: The invoice discount or shipping-only PATCH path has no transaction or lock, so a concurrent items edit and discount PATCH can store a total inconsistent with the lines
symptom: From the lead (pre-existing, found with #3135). A concurrent items edit and a discount PATCH can store a total inconsistent with the lines because this path has no transaction or lock. Money, api, medium.

title: A draft invoice with a pre-applied order credit can be discounted below the amount already paid
location: apps/api invoices.service.ts update() discount path; order credit application
symptom: From the lead (pre-existing, found with #3135). A draft invoice with a pre-applied order credit can be discounted below the amount already paid. Money, api, medium.

title: Invoice dto.discount is not rounded at intake (1-cent skew) and the legacy negative-subtotal error text reads discount (0) cannot exceed subtotal (-35)
location: apps/api invoices.service.ts discount intake; legacy negative-subtotal error message
symptom: From the lead (pre-existing, found with #3135). dto.discount is not rounded at intake (a 1-cent skew), and the legacy negative-subtotal error text reads discount (0) cannot exceed subtotal (-35). Money and error text, api, low.

title: Route every invoice-totals writer through assertInvoiceTotalsSane (the NOT-WORSE rule): reconcileOrderDraftInvoice, rebuildSiblingDrafts and the order-to-invoice resync paths
location: apps/api reconcileOrderDraftInvoice (including ISSUED deposit mirrors); rebuildSiblingDrafts; order to invoice resync paths in orders.service.ts; assertInvoiceTotalsSane
symptom: From SA-651 (#2554 5977359624), via the Mac Lead. Every invoice-totals writer should go through assertInvoiceTotalsSane (the NOT-WORSE rule): reconcileOrderDraftInvoice (including ISSUED deposit mirrors), rebuildSiblingDrafts, and the order to invoice resync paths in orders.service.ts. Money, api, medium.

title: A background reconcile rewrites the totals of ISSUED deposit-mirror invoices: ALLOWED by SA-652 only with conditions C1-C4 (tier-1 fix, after B1048, not this release)
location: apps/api reconcileOrderDraftInvoice background reconcile; ISSUED deposit-mirror invoices
symptom: From SA-651 (#2554 5977359624), ruled by SA-652 (#2554 5977371228) via the Mac Lead. A background reconcile rewrites the totals of ISSUED deposit-mirror invoices. RULING: ALLOWED, with required conditions C1 (resyncInvoiceLedger in the deposit-mirror branch), C2 (an audit row recording before and after), C3 (an overpayment signal, never a silent PAID) and C4 (the B1048 assertInvoiceTotalsSane guard). Tier-1 fix, money, api. Lane: Mac docs, after B1048. NOT this release.

title: Editing the quantity of an already-delivered order line double-decrements stock: settleStockForEdit never applies deliveredQty on the increase side and its decrease cap is pooled per product, not per line
symptom: From the lead (separate Opus refute-first pass; evidence in the lead's hunt-conservation notes). settleStockForEdit never applies deliveredQty on the increase side and its decrease cap is pooled per product rather than per line. Repros: stock 100 and a line of 10 delivered, edit to 6 then 10 gives 86 (true 90); 4 of 10 delivered, 10 to 2 to 10 gives 88; pooled: removing a delivered line A (5 of 5) while B (5, undelivered) stays gives 95. Fix: a per-line clamp on both sides (effHeld = max(held, delivered), effReq = max(req, delivered), matched by line id). Stock, tier 1, api, high. Lane: PC builder G, after live stock.

title: A lower re-price on a PARTIAL invoice can recompute to PAID while the invoice is overpaid
location: apps/api invoice re-price and status recompute on a PARTIAL invoice (price adjustment path)
symptom: From the lead (earlier Opus finding). A lower re-price on a PARTIAL invoice can recompute the status to PAID while the invoice is overpaid, hiding the overpayment. Money, api, medium. Relates to B1049 condition C3 (an overpayment signal, never a silent PAID).

title: A credit note is double-spent under concurrent settlement: the settle path writes an absolute amountUsed with no lock on the credit note
location: apps/api credit-notes.service.ts applyCreditInTx (~883-893) and settleOrderCreditsInTx; FOR UPDATE exists only on void (~1268)
symptom: From the lead (separate Opus refute-first pass; details in the lead's local hunt notes). applyCreditInTx writes an absolute amountUsed with no credit-note lock on the settle path; reachable through two office invoice paths, or office first then driver. Fix: lock the notes FOR UPDATE in id order in settleOrderCreditsInTx, write an increment, and do the same on restore. Test: a db.spec barrier case where the total stays at 100. Money, tier 1, api, high. Lane: Mac.

title: The pending-order merge transaction never re-checks eligibility and deletes losers by id only, so a concurrent cancel, invoice or route assignment can leave an orphan invoice billed twice
symptom: From the lead (separate Opus refute-first pass; details in the lead's local hunt notes). The merge tx never re-checks eligibility and deletes losers by id only. Cancel, invoice and route assignment do not take the merge lock, and the invoice foreign keys are SET NULL, so an orphan invoice can be billed twice. Fix: lock the orders FOR UPDATE in id order, re-select with the eligibility filter inside the tx, and make the delete conditional with a count check. Money, tier 1, api, high. Lane: Mac.

title: Generate order now can double-submit and the template order generation has no idempotency
symptom: From the lead (separate Opus refute-first pass; details in the lead's local hunt notes). The Generate order now button can double-submit and generateOrder has no idempotency. Fix: disable the button while pending, plus a short same-template guard or an Idempotency-Key. Web and api, medium. Lane: Mac.

title: Customer self-service profile update: restrict to contact fields
symptom: Verified by the lead (details in the lead's local notes, kept out of this record). Missing field allowlist on the self-service profile update. Fix: restrict the update to contact fields. Security, api, critical. Lane: Mac, top priority, lands in the next window.

title: Protect admin accounts from non-admin user actions
symptom: Verified by the lead (details in the lead's local notes, kept out of this record). Missing role check on user actions that target admin accounts. Security, api, high. Lane: Mac, top priority, lands in the next window.

title: Validate buyer template line input
symptom: Verified by the lead (details in the lead's local notes, kept out of this record). Missing DTO validation on buyer template line input. Security, api, high. Lane: Mac, top priority, lands in the next window.

title: Bulk re-price should run as one transaction (follow-up to the B1031 up-front judging)
location: apps/api price-adjustment-ledger.ts bulk re-price path; follow-up to B1031 (#3161 review)
symptom: From the lead's #3161 review, via the Mac Lead. A single-transaction bulk re-price, as a follow-up to B1031's up-front judging. Money, api, medium. Lane: Mac.

title: FulfilmentMethod hand-types FulfillPath: add FULFILL_PATH_VALUES to the shared enums with a parity pin (L-072)
location: packages/types/api/enums.ts; apps/web FulfilmentMethod (#3188 review); the 409 spec
symptom: From the lead's #3188 review, via the Mac Lead (non-blocking). FulfilmentMethod hand-types FulfillPath, against lesson L-072. Add FULFILL_PATH_VALUES to packages/types/api/enums.ts with the enum-parity pin, type it as FulfillPath | PICKUP once the PICKUP migration lands, mark the raw modes keys not for gating, and reuse one promise in the 409 spec. Types and web, low. Lane: U-units, next session.

title: Customer-facing reads may expose credit and pricing-tier fields; ruling needed
symptom: Customer-role reads of the customer record return creditLimit and pricingTier; whether a buyer may see them is unruled. Needs an SA ruling before any change.

title: Driver removal can change a protected admin account flag without the admin guard
symptom: Removing a driver record clears a capability flag on the linked user even when that user is the protected admin account; the admin-account guard is not consulted.

title: Fulfilment mode read failure silently answers unset instead of 503
symptom: fulfilment_model/counter_sales reads use .catch(() => 'unset'); a failed read for a ship tenant would answer ROUTE. Must return 503 FEATURES_UNAVAILABLE in or before the first PR whose behaviour reads capabilities.fulfilment (SA final read of #3188).

title: Counter-sale line edits restock goods because deliveredQty stays 0
symptom: Per SA-655, counter sales go DELIVERED without stamping deliveredQty; a later line edit down treats goods as undelivered and returns them to stock. Until B1050 lands, corrections must go through returns/credit notes; fix after B1050.

title: Order-template rows with non-positive quantities fail silently in the scheduled run
symptom: Pre-existing template rows with qty <= 0 are now refused by validation and the scheduled run fails without surfacing it. Needs an owner-gated read-only count before any change; never touch live-tenant rows.

title: Portal-only buyers may be refused on template pause/resume
symptom: Template ownership appears to be looked up by a user id that portal-only buyers do not have, so pause/resume may return 403. Needs a repro first.

title: Billing subscribe with add-ons must return a coded 400
symptom: subscribe() given a non-empty addons[] must refuse with a coded 400 and a pin (SA-658 F1). API-only today.

title: Add-on quantity change can race an admin disable
symptom: Inside the tx require current.active and the same stripeItemId else a retryable 409; the admin disable must take the billing add-on lock (SA-658 F2).

title: Billing provider item deletes run before the transaction's refusals
symptom: Provider-side item deletes happen before the plan-key/B58 checks; move the checks first and add a compensating step on failure (SA-658 F3).

title: Billing mode keyed on subscription-id presence; dead subscriptions never cleared
symptom: A tenant with a dead subscription id is treated as provider-billed and fails closed with 503 on manual paths (SA-658 F4). Owner-gated read-only count later.

title: Trial add-ons should bill at card checkout
symptom: Owner ruling 2026-10-04 (SA-659 option 1): add-ons chosen during a trial bill at card checkout. Follow-up from #3129 F5/F6; not tonight.

title: Price history marks short-delivered or edited lines as not invoiced yet
symptom: SA-661: the remainder predicate shows 'not invoiced yet' for a short-delivered or post-invoice-edited line; it must compare against invoiced qty on the line's own basis.

title: Price history cost read includes sale movements
symptom: SA-661: the avg-cost-at-sale read must filter stock movements with type {not: 'SALE'}.

title: Price history per-unit cost not rounded through the pricing helpers
symptom: SA-661: perUnit must be roundMoney(costPerSellingUnit()) from @routeflow/pricing, not an inline division.

title: Price history summaries mix different pack sizes
symptom: SA-661: group summaries must key on (unitLabel, unitsPerBox) so different pack sizes are not averaged together.

title: Mobile buyer order page shows no tracking for shipped orders
symptom: SHIP orders show no carrier/tracking info on the mobile customer app order page; web is handled by #3200.

title: Standing-order template orders ignore the customer's stored fulfilment path (unset/delivery/both tenants)
symptom: Template-created orders use tx.order.create with no fulfillPath, so the DB default ROUTE applies even when Customer.fulfillPath = SHIP; OrdersService.create resolves dto ?? customer ?? ROUTE. Lead ruling 2026-10-04: keep today's behaviour for unset/delivery/both; the resolver PR covers ship-only. Product question for the owner.

title: Annual-plan add-on refusal needs its own error code
symptom: SA-669 nit: the annual refusal shares a generic 409; give it its own code and key the web copy on it.

title: Trial add-on copy should say free during trial then the monthly price
symptom: SA-669 nit: reword trial UNBILLED copy to 'free during your trial, then $X/mo'; pairs with B1070.

title: A 100%-off Stripe subscription must be treated as a pilot (add-ons not billed)
symptom: Owner ruling 2026-10-04: pilots stay free; a tenant whose Stripe sub carries a 100%-off coupon is a pilot, yet add-ons are billed at full catalog price.

title: Profile-granted modules are free comps and must not bill
symptom: Owner ruling 2026-10-04: a module switched on by a business-profile GRANT is a free comp; it must not create a Stripe item or charge.

title: Price history: an unknown pack still passes in the unit-hint branch
symptom: Follow-up from the #3193 review: with a unit hint present, a row or line whose pack is unknown does not block a unit match; consider failing closed like the no-hint branch.

title: Out-for-delivery carrier orders: delete and reopen paths still restock
symptom: Follow-up to #3204's cancel fix (L6): deleteOrder and reopenOrder on an out-for-delivery SHIP order can still return units already with the carrier to stock.

title: Web shows Cancel for an out-for-delivery shipped order
location: apps/web order detail; needs a server flag on the order
symptom: The web Cancel action stays visible for an out-for-delivery SHIP order; hide it from a server-provided flag rather than client status logic.

title: Price history at 390: order-number placement is inconsistent
symptom: #3193 judge N3: at 390 a row with the 'not invoiced yet' pill puts the order number on its own line while other rows keep it inline; always place the reference on its own line on mobile.

title: Price history shows masked cost columns before Show cost
symptom: #3193 judge N4: with cost hidden, '····' placeholders fill two full columns; hide AVG COST and MARGIN until Show cost is clicked.

title: Shipment-settled billing trusts any legacy shippedAt
symptom: Follow-up from #3204 (S4/S1): settledAtShipment treats any stamped shippedAt as a real shipment, including one written by an earlier pre-ship tracking save. Rule: before switching an EXISTING tenant to ship/both/pickup_ship, run a read-only count of its orders with such a shippedAt; new onboarding tenants are unaffected.

title: Auto-merge folds orders of different fulfilment paths, so a per-order SHIP choice is silently lost
symptom: Auto-merge ignores fulfillPath, so a per-order SHIP choice merged into a ROUTE order is lost. Fixed by #3208 (merge predicate); SA-676 rules the change acceptable for unset tenants as a defect fix. Before deploy: an owner-gated READ-ONLY census (counts only): customers with open orders on both paths; SHIP customers with active standing orders.

title: Billing guard tightening
symptom: A billing add-on guard was applied inconsistently across related actions. Fixed by #3129 (fold); details with the lead.

title: Each self-serve add-on enable creates a new Stripe Product; disable never archives it
symptom: Every enable calls products.create inline, so Stripe accumulates one Product per enable and disable never archives them (6 created in one sandbox checklist). Reuse one Product per SKU (lookup by metadata/lookup_key) or archive on disable. Follow-up from the #3129 checklist.

title: An order split into partial invoices is double-billed when it is delivered or edited
symptom: Pre-existing, live for all tenants (SA-681 confirmed by read). The legacy branch of reconcileOrderDraftInvoice rebuilds the OLDEST open partial draft invoice to the FULL order while the other partial invoices still bill, so the order is billed twice. Triggers: Mark Delivered, undelivered edits, the merge winner. Fix in progress: PC builder, branch fix/split-invoice-double-bill. Owner-gated READ-ONLY census pending (SA queries A and B in .claude/handoffs/2026-10-04-sa-rulings.md, SA-681).

title: A quantity cut on a shipment invoice is re-billed as a second invoice at delivery
symptom: Ship-mode only, live since #3204; no live tenant affected. recomputeOrderFromInvoices rewrites order lines only on full coverage (SA-674b), so a qty cut on a shipment-sent invoice is billed again as a second invoice when the order is delivered. To be fixed in #3207-v2 by the SA-674b rule.

title: Commission statement generation can create duplicates under concurrent requests
symptom: Check-then-create runs outside a transaction, so two concurrent generate calls can both pass the existence check and create duplicate statements. Sibling found while fixing B1054 (#3214).

title: Template-generated order numbers can collide within the same millisecond
symptom: Order numbers derived from Date.now() can collide when different templates generate in the same millisecond, raising a unique violation (Order_tenantId_orderNumber_key) instead of creating the order. Sibling found while fixing B1054 (#3214).

title: A buyer order submitted twice (retry after a lost response or timeout) doubles the quantities
symptom: No Idempotency-Key on POST /buyer/orders and the merge lock only serializes, so a retried submit merges again and doubles quantities; both clients keep the cart and say try again; the post-commit sweep rethrows. Fix shape: per-cart-session key checked inside the lock (merge-idempotency.ts helpers); post-commit errors logged, never rethrown. Verified by an independent refute-first pass; live for every tenant.

title: A status change racing a cancel overwrites CANCELLED
location: apps/api/src/orders/orders.service.ts (:2340 pre-read, :2661 update by id only)
symptom: A status transition reads the order, then updates by id only, so a concurrent cancel is overwritten (buyer cancel vs staff Confirm; cancel vs Mark delivered shows delivered, unbilled, stock credited). Fix shape: updateMany where {id, status: prior} and a coded 409 on count 0, before any invoicing/notification. Verified refute-first; live for every tenant.

title: Concurrent draft-invoice rebuilds can double every line while the total stays single
location: apps/api/src/invoices/invoices.service.ts (:1521 deleteMany + :1522 nested create, no tx)
symptom: Two rebuilds of the same draft (two staff marking delivered, a delivery racing an edit, or POST /invoices/from-order) interleave deleteMany and create outside a transaction, doubling lines while the stored total stays single. Fix shape: one tx locking the order then the draft (same order update() uses), re-reading under the lock. Verified refute-first; live for every tenant.

title: A manual template generate replay is lost if the pending-order merge folds the first order within 30 seconds
symptom: Follow-up to #3214: the replay looks for a live order of the same template created within 30 s; if the pending-order merge folded that order into another, a second press creates a new order. Idea: a durable key (a TEMPLATE:<id> stock movement) and a replayed flag so the web can say Already generated.

title: A post-delivery order-line edit can silently mark an overpaid invoice PAID
symptom: Lowering a delivered order's line re-syncs a SENT/PARTIAL invoice below what was paid and settles it PAID with the overpayment shown nowhere. Same class as B1051 (#3212), not covered by B1049 C3; the invoice-edit path is DRAFT-only and safe.

title: Tenant guard hardening
symptom: Details held by the lead and SA (SA-685). Fix in progress on a PC builder branch. An owner-gated read-only census is pending (counts only).

title: Customer-facing response hardening (part 1)
symptom: Details held by the lead. Fix in progress (cloud builder); same PR as B1101.

title: Customer-facing response hardening (part 2)
symptom: Details held by the lead. Fixed in the same PR as B1100.

title: Catalog includedAtPlan is an unvalidated string; a typo bills add-ons on every plan
location: apps/api/src/billing (plan catalog includedAtPlan, #3129 F3 inclusion check)
symptom: includedAtPlan is free text; an unknown or misspelled plan key silently disables the plan-included refusal, so the add-on bills on every plan. Validate at publish/startup and refuse to bill on an unknown key.

title: Plan upgrades keep billing add-ons the new plan includes
location: apps/api/src/billing (upgrade() POST /billing/upgrade, subscribe() with addons[], admin plan setters)
symptom: TIER-1, gates card go-live (SA-686). Plan changes never retire add-ons the new plan includes. Fix shape: one step that deletes the Stripe item Stripe-first with create_prorations, writes the STOP notice for MANUAL, deactivates the row and emits the add-on delta to 0; planChangePreview lists the stopped charge; F3 re-checks under the add-on lock. Red: GROWTH + STRIPE FORECASTING with an item -> upgrade(SCALE) gives no delete, row stays active, no delta.

title: The in-app plan upgrade never changes the Stripe subscription price
location: apps/api/src/billing (upgrade path; only platform-admin pushes the price)
symptom: TIER-1, gates card go-live (SA-686). A self-serve upgrade updates the plan locally but never updates the Stripe subscription price; only the platform-admin path pushes it, so the tenant keeps being charged the old plan price.

title: A pre-delivery split invoice is silently undone by a later order edit, and partials don't follow price edits
symptom: Follow-up from #3216/SA-687: a split invoice created before dispatch is undone by a later order edit, and partial invoices do not follow price edits. Fix shape: refuse createPartialFromOrder before dispatch with a coded 409 (needs an OWNER yes; removes a capability) plus a review conflict at Mark Delivered when the sum of invoices differs from the order total.

title: Tenant guard hardening (part 2): reference validation in other modules
symptom: SA-685 class, details with the lead. A builder is assigned after part 1 (B1099) lands.

title: The split-invoice review check counts a hand-added invoice product line as orphaned
symptom: Follow-up from #3216 (SA-687a): the review conflict counts an invoice product line added by hand as orphaned. Fix: count an orphan only when its productId matches a live order line; add negative pins for that and for a regulated split with a SENT sibling.

title: Counter-table write scoping
symptom: Tenant-guard family (SA-688a); details with the lead.

title: Order line items table clips its status column on narrow phones
symptom: At 390px width the order detail Line Items table clips its STATUS column on the right edge. Seen during #3219 Playwright proof; not caused by #3219.

title: Charged-today proration can include a previous change's lines when changes are close together
symptom: The proration read window starts 2 s before the call, so a second add-on change within ~2 s picks up the first change's proration lines: observed 147.20 (true 98.13) and 49.06 (true -49.07) in the Stripe sandbox; the BillingEvent prorated payload is wrong too. Stripe charges are correct. Fix in the Option A PR: filter on this call's own subscription_item proration lines created at/after the call start (no backdating) or use the update response's invoice preview; pin two changes 1 s apart. Must be fixed before card go-live.

title: Products bulk-select Delete button is off-screen and untappable on phones
symptom: At 390px width in select mode, the bulk bar's red 'Delete N items' button sits at x 351-479 in a 390px viewport and is clipped by main's overflow-x-hidden, so it cannot be tapped. Found during #3224 Playwright proof; pre-existing.

title: Billing has no platform-admin alert channel for refused checkouts
symptom: When a checkout completion is refused (e.g. a customer mismatch, #3226), the session's add-on items can keep billing in Stripe with no row owning them; this is visible only in the STRIPE_CHECKOUT_REFUSED trail and error logs. Billing notifications go to the tenant's own admins, so there is no platform-admin alert. Add one.

title: Undelivered orders with unlinked invoice lines will need review after the split-invoice fix
symptom: Pre-landing data note for #3216: the 2026-10-05 read-only census found 8 undelivered orders across 2 tenants whose non-void invoice carries product lines with no linked order line (40 lines, 0 freeform). After #3216 lands, Mark Delivered on these returns ORDER_INVOICES_NEED_REVIEW until staff review them. Plan a heads-up or a guided review.

title: Inventory-purchase auto-routing does not recognise a shared purchase category
symptom: Pre-existing: the inventory-purchase auto-routing only matches a tenant-owned INVENTORY_PURCHASE category, so it never fires when the category is the shared (global) one. Fix: look up tenant-or-global.

title: Order-column idempotency replay does not check the cart fingerprint
symptom: A key reused with a different cart through the Order column is replayed, not refused; only the merge-fold table stores a fingerprint. Clients rotate keys today. Needs a cart fingerprint column (a migration). Follow-up to #3228 (B1094); pinned by the spec in #3240.

title: Office order page has no "invoices need review" badge
symptom: After #3216, Mark Delivered and Generate Invoice answer 409 ORDER_INVOICES_NEED_REVIEW for the few orders whose invoices no longer match their lines, and staff had no sign of it before the 409.

title: Mobile buyer shows a partly paid invoice's full total as Due
symptom: The mobile buyer reads invoice.amountDue, a field the API never returns, so a partly paid invoice shows the full total as Due.

title: 390px Create Order price-history popover overshoots the viewport and detaches after a wheel scroll
symptom: At 390px the popover overshoots the viewport edge by about 2px, and after a wheel scroll it no longer follows its trigger.

title: Business profile could only be applied through the API, with no screen
symptom: The shipping wholesaler profile, needed for the demo, could only be applied by calling the API; the back office had no picker, preview or Setup tab.

title: Adjust Prices accepted sub-cent unit prices, so line totals drifted
symptom: A typed 8.355 was stored as 8.36 but the line subtotal came from the raw 8.355 (6 x 8.36 showed 50.13, not 50.16), and the next adjust drifted again.

title: Tracking added before Mark shipped is not copied to the shipment invoice
symptom: Tracking entered on the order before Mark shipped does not reach the shipment invoice. Fix is in open #3223.

title: Buyer portal invoices AMOUNT column shows N/A
symptom: The AMOUNT column on the buyer portal invoices list reads N/A. Fix is in open #3235.

title: Buyer cart says "Add to existing order" when there is no existing order
symptom: The buyer cart offers Add to existing order wording even when the buyer has no existing order.

title: Buyer cart clips its money columns at 1440 and 390
symptom: At 1440 and at 390 the buyer cart clips its money columns.

title: Shipped carrier orders read "Out for Delivery" and a Shipped chip shows on PENDING ship orders
symptom: A carrier order that has shipped reads Out for Delivery, and a Shipped chip appears on ship orders that are still PENDING. Fix is in open #3198.

title: Create order and customer forms are not ship-aware on ship-only tenants, plus a customer-assignments 403
symptom: On a ship-only tenant the create order and create customer forms still ask route questions, and the customer-assignments request answers 403. Fix is in open #3198.

title: Order-confirmed email reads "for delivery on ." with a blank date, with route wording on ship orders
symptom: An order with no requested delivery date produced a sentence ending in a blank date, and a carrier-shipped order was described with delivery wording.

title: Bulk cancel or delete of carrier orders gives a generic or wrong reason
symptom: When a bulk cancel or delete skips carrier orders, the summary gives a generic or wrong reason. Fix is in open #3232.

title: Buyer shipped order shows no carrier or tracking
symptom: The buyer's view of a shipped order does not show the carrier or the tracking details.

title: Buyer orders list ITEMS column is always an em dash
symptom: The ITEMS column on the buyer orders list always reads as a dash. Fix is in open #3235.

title: Order detail shows "Order not found." when the request fails with a 500
symptom: A server error while loading an order detail is shown as Order not found.

title: Admin "How orders reach customers" row does not show the applied mode
symptom: After a business profile is applied, the How orders reach customers row does not show the mode that was applied. Demo item D14; the PC builder owns the fix.

title: Invoices-need-review badge tooltip uses a native title, unreachable by tap
symptom: The badge explains itself through a native title attribute, so on a phone the reason cannot be reached by tapping.

title: Hide staff order actions for customer logins
symptom: The staff order page showed its full action bar to customer logins, which the server already refuses.

title: Change request on a shipped order dead-ends in a misleading edit-window error
symptom: A with-carrier order has no route run, so a change request answered EDIT_WINDOW_OPEN while the buyer edit refusal told the customer to send a change request: a loop with no exit.

title: Role-matrix guard
symptom: Express the order-status role rules as a declarative guard as well as the service-level gate (defence in depth); follow-up to #3238.

title: Change request on a delivered order shows a misleading edit-window error
symptom: A change request on a delivered order answers with an edit-window error; it should refuse with a code that points to returns. Follow-up to #3238 (B1135).

title: B1090 follow-up: orphan-line check misses a renamed custom line or an edited draft description
symptom: The orphan-line test only counts an unlinked invoice line when it matches a live order line by product or by a live custom line's name, so a renamed custom line or an edited draft description is not recognised. Follow-up to #3216.

title: Chip or manual add tapped before price history loads prices at list and never re-applies the last-given price
symptom: A usually-buys chip or a manual add tapped before /orders/price-history has loaded prices the line at list, and the last-given price is not applied once the history arrives.

title: At 390 the Shipments table clips the SHIPPED, STATUS and action columns
symptom: At 390px the Shipments table uses overflow-hidden and is not scrollable, so the SHIPPED, STATUS and action columns are cut off.

title: An unrecognised saved carrier pre-selects Other, and Ship-with-tracking saves other, losing the custom name
symptom: A saved carrier that is not in the list pre-selects Other, and saving Ship with tracking stores other, so the custom carrier name is lost.

title: ACTIVE and UNBILLED add-on copy says an account manager will set up billing, though card checkout bills
symptom: The copy for an ACTIVE but unbilled add-on says an account manager will set up billing, while card checkout now bills it.

title: Retired CHECKOUT_ADDONS_PENDING_FALLBACK path is still in the web
symptom: The CHECKOUT_ADDONS_PENDING_FALLBACK handling is retired on the API but still present in the web.

title: Remove ADDON_BILLING_PENDING_CHECKOUT once the web stops consuming it
symptom: ADDON_BILLING_PENDING_CHECKOUT stays in the API and shared types until the web no longer reads it; then it can go.

title: Profile picker does not mark the applied profile
symptom: The business-profile picker does not mark which profile is currently applied. Follow-up to #3220.

title: Comp lines in the profile preview do not say comp
symptom: Complimentary add-on lines in the profile preview are not labelled comp. Follow-up to #3220.

title: Profile Setup tab Retry buttons render as plain text
symptom: The Retry buttons on the profile Setup tab render as plain text instead of buttons. Follow-up to #3220.

title: Profile preview has no capabilities or fleet summary
symptom: The business-profile preview does not summarise the capabilities or fleet modules the profile turns on. Follow-up to #3220.

title: Order again copy when only part of a past order is added
symptom: When Order again adds only some lines of a past order, the notice wording (for example N items could not be added) needs a copy pass. Follow-up to #3218.

title: Buyer invoice detail clips its money tiles and Items table at 390
location: apps/web/app/buyer/portal/[seller]/invoices/[id]/page.tsx (money tiles are a fixed grid-cols-4 at :274; Items table)
symptom: At 390px the money tiles are a fixed grid-cols-4 and the Items table scrolls sideways, so totals and subtotals are visibly cut off. Demo-visible; the MacBook is fixing it.

title: Buyer invoice detail Payment History STATUS column is empty for CASH rows
symptom: On the buyer invoice detail page the STATUS cell of the Payment History table is empty for CASH payment rows.

title: Comps with a stale snapshot are counted in platform-admin and billing-cron sums
symptom: Add-on rows granted as comps (isComp) that still carry a stale price snapshot are summed at these sites. They need isComp:false in the where, as MrrService already does through billableAddonWhere. Follow-up to #3231 and #3226.

title: A manual tenant activated before its card session completes keeps externalPayment true
symptom: Pre-existing. When a tenant is moved to manual invoicing before its card checkout session completes, the completion path never clears externalPayment (upsertArgs does not write it), so both billing paths stay live for that tenant.

title: A stale pointer on a manual activation from a cancelled Stripe subscription gets no DUE notice
symptom: Pre-existing. A manual activation of a tenant whose stored Stripe subscription pointer is stale (the subscription was cancelled) writes no DUE notice, so the first manual invoice is not announced.

title: A TRIAL set READ_ONLY by admin updateStatus has a null readOnlyReason, so its later manual activation prices nothing
symptom: Under-bill. A trial tenant moved to READ_ONLY through the admin updateStatus path has readOnlyReason null, so keepsTrialAddons cannot tell it was a trial and its later manual activation prices none of the add-ons that ran free. Found in review of #3226.

title: 'Stored subscription is live' silence can hide a real double charge; rely on hasAppliedMarker
symptom: Must fix before Stripe goes live. When the stored subscription reads as live, the checkout completion stays silent about a second paid session, which can hide a real double charge. With the plan-transition flag on, the decision must rely on hasAppliedMarker. Found in review of #3226.

title: Cancelling a superseded subscription that is `incomplete` can cancel an ACH payment still processing, so the tenant pays twice
symptom: Must fix before Stripe goes live. A superseded stored subscription in status incomplete may hold a bank debit that is still processing; cancelling it can let that payment settle while the replacement also charges, so the tenant pays twice. Fix: read latest_invoice.payment_intent.status; if processing do not cancel and raise a notice (the owner keeps bank debits); re-read the status right before the cancel. Found in review of #3226.

title: 360px buyer Payment History table clips
symptom: At 360px the buyer invoice detail Payment History table is clipped. Sibling of B1150 and B1151.

title: Bulk delete of carrier orders shows the wrong 'recorded payments' reason
symptom: Pre-existing. The bulk-delete summary hardcodes the recorded-payments reason for every skipped order, so skipped carrier orders read as payment-blocked. It should show the API's coded reason and a matching hint in the selection bar. Residual of B1128 after #3232 (which fixed the cancel summary and left this line).

title: Dashboard Recent Orders badge reads PENDING while the list and detail read SHIPPED
symptom: When tracking is set before the order is marked shipped, the dashboard badge reads PENDING but the list and detail read SHIPPED. The dashboard payload lacks shippingTrackingNumber, so the client cannot derive the same status.

title: A fleet-off seller with no fulfilment profile (unset) still gets the buyer route timeline and the Track your delivery driver card
symptom: With the fleet off and no fulfilment profile set (unset capability), the buyer order page still shows the route timeline and the Track your delivery or driver card, which a seller without a fleet cannot honour.

title: 'Pending Deliveries' tile shows on a ship-only buyer dashboard
symptom: A buyer of a ship-only seller still sees a Pending Deliveries tile on the dashboard; it should read as shipments or be hidden when the seller does not deliver by route. Found in the demo review.

title: 'Requested Delivery Date' shows on a ship-only buyer cart
symptom: The buyer cart of a ship-only seller still asks for a Requested Delivery Date, which has no meaning when orders go by carrier. Found in the demo review. Distinct from B1126 (staff create-order and customer forms).

title: A cancelled subscription keeps stripeItemId on its add-on rows, so a re-subscribe leaves the add-on free
symptom: After a Stripe subscription is cancelled the add-on rows keep their stripeItemId pointer. A later re-subscribe then reads the add-on as already billed (item present) while the new subscription has no such item, so the add-on runs free. Distinct from B107 (disableAddon nulling the pointer on a failed delete).

title: A stop recompute clamps deliveredQty to min(sum, qty), so a qty edit below the delivered amount erases the delivered floor (B1050 follow-up, #3175)
symptom: Follow-up to B1050 / #3175. The recompute sets deliveredQty = min(sum of rows, qty). After an edit drops qty below what was already delivered, a later stop recompute lowers deliveredQty to the new qty and the delivered floor is lost.

title: Replace-all order item rewrite recreates lines with deliveredQty 0, losing delivered history (B1050 follow-up, #3175)
symptom: Follow-up to B1050 / #3175. The replace-all path deletes every order line and recreates it with deliveredQty 0, so delivered history is lost. Same path as #3244's N1; fix them together.

title: Investigate: do returns restock caps use qty or delivered after qty is reduced below delivered? (B1050 follow-up, #3175)
symptom: Investigation item, follow-up to B1050 / #3175. Verify whether the returns restock caps cap at the ordered qty or at the delivered amount once an edit has reduced qty below delivered; if they cap at qty, a return can restock less (or more) than was delivered. Severity low to medium pending the check.

title: Bookkeeping paymentsThisWeek counts the week from Sunday in server-local time
symptom: paymentsThisWeek starts the week on Sunday in the server's local time. It should use the shared tenant-local Sunday-start week helper that #3145 adds (calendarWeekBounds): the week starts Sunday 00:00 tenant-local, DST-safe, a null zone falls back to UTC (owner ruling).

title: reopenOrder has no carrier guard
symptom: reopenOrder has no carrier guard and no spec pins it. Same with-carrier family as B1082 (delete and reopen paths) and B1167 (replace-all rewrite). Split out of B1082, whose delete half #3219 fixed.

title: Displayed monthly subscription figure prices comp add-ons (tenant sees more than is charged)
symptom: getSubscription prices comp add-ons in the displayed monthly figure, so the tenant sees more than is charged. Cross-ref B1152 (comp sums elsewhere).

title: deleteOrder deletes OrderItems before the Order with no Order row lock
symptom: deleteOrder deletes OrderItems before the Order and takes no Order row lock, a deadlock shape against any other Order locker. Fix: take the Order FOR UPDATE first. Cross-ref B1053.

title: Merge fingerprint omits notes, overrideReason and trackedCategoryId
symptom: The merge fingerprint omits notes, overrideReason and trackedCategoryId (non-money), so a change between the pre-read and the lock leads to a stale overwrite. B1053 follow-up.

title: walk-in customer guard follow-up (users API status/reset)
symptom: Follow-up to #3211. Detail kept in the lead's local notes.

title: walk-in customer guard follow-up (customer edit + buyer link)
symptom: Follow-up to #3211. Detail kept in the lead's local notes.

title: mobile walk-in delete control
symptom: Follow-up to #3211. Detail kept in the lead's local notes.

title: Buyer cart says the items were added to your existing order when the chosen fulfilment path differs
symptom: The banner and redirect say the items were added to the existing order although the chosen fulfilment path differs. The server result is right; only the wording and redirect are wrong.

title: Pickup-complete on a counter-sale order writes a claim row
symptom: Completing pickup on a counter-sale order writes a claim row it does not need.

title: An already-picked-up note is shown after an invoice-step failure
symptom: After the invoice step fails, the sale shows an already-picked-up note.

title: Global API error toast duplicates or contradicts the pickup dialog copy
location: apps/web (global mutation error toast; pickup dialog)
symptom: The global API error toast and the pickup dialog both show copy for the same failure, and the two can disagree. Rated low to medium by the lead; filed low.

title: Counter-sale dialog keeps a stale paid state after the account-required error (#3252)
symptom: After the account-required error the dialog keeps its earlier paid state.

title: Till cosmetics at 390: scan placeholder clipped, remove-x tap padding too small, toast covers the banner
symptom: Three cosmetic faults at 390: the scan placeholder is clipped, the remove-x has too little tap padding, and the toast covers the banner. Cf. B1044.

title: janitor orphan step crashes: it calls rmdir on files
symptom: The janitor's orphan step calls rmdir on paths that are files, so the run crashes instead of skipping or unlinking them.

title: web Create Order draft does not persist appliedCredits (mobile does)
symptom: Parking a web Create Order draft and resuming it drops the applied credits; the mobile draft payload round-trips appliedCredits. Web/mobile parity gap.

title: mobile Create Order has no handler for IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CART_MISMATCH
symptom: When the server answers a keyed create with the coded cart-mismatch conflict (with orderId), mobile shows a generic error instead of opening the existing order as web does (#3256).

title: P2002 unique-violation readers miss the pg driver adapter error shape (meta.target unset), so races surface as raw 500s
location: apps/api/src: estimates.service ~:242, credit-notes.service ~:513, orders.service ~:2270, inline-returns.service ~:87 (+ any other meta.target reader)
symptom: With the pg driver adapter, Prisma leaves meta.target unset on P2002 and puts the index in meta.driverAdapterError.cause.constraint; every code path that detects a unique-key race by reading meta.target never matches, so the loser of a concurrent insert gets a raw P2002/500 instead of its retry/replay. Found by #3256 (BUG-A A4). SA-717.

title: tenant billing export returns internal fields; needs an explicit allowlist
symptom: The tenant billing export should project its rows through explicit allowlists (SA-718). Detail kept in the lead's notes.

title: Invoicing settings: Invoice Number Prefix and Default days until payment is due are shown but never saved
symptom: PATCH /settings drops both fields (the names appear nowhere in apps/api/src), so the saved values never persist; the real invoice due date comes from Payment Terms (invoices.service.ts ~:2475-2487). Found by the apple-ux Settings walk.
